text:
amy: Quick sync — proposing a pilot for a 'soft eviction credit' addon. idea: non-latency-critical reserved tenants can opt into a softer preempt window (longer drain + staged throttles) in exchange for reduced monthly commit. want to validate ops load, customer appetite, and launch criteria.
derek: sounds promising. curious about exact tradeoffs — what does "softer preempt window" mean numerically?
sofia: +1 but we need clear SLOs. ops load is the big unknown. also need observability hooks for spillover detection.
jason: a couple of incoming deals asked for cheaper reserved options w/ relaxed guarantees. they'd love this if we can quantify behavior.
amy: rough numbers: normal preempt window = 30s drain; soft = 180s drain + 2-stage token-throttle before eviction. discounts in proposal: -20% commit fee.
derek: ok, engineering checks: 1) can autoscaler accept gradual shed signals? 2) will KV cache invalidation be safe during 180s?
sofia: add telemetry: per-tenant preemption events, latency p95/99 during drain, queue growth, and eviction rate. need dashboard and an alert if p99 latency increases > 20% in prod.
autoscale-bot: canary deployed adaptive-shed v0.3 to prod-alpha yesterday, saw 12% lower immediate eviction rate, but 8% latency blips on heavy tails. logs: `shed.events=42, avg_drain=160s`
jason: customer-facing note: we must be explicit about opt-in and show estimated risk model. Sales wants a short one-pager + sample SLA language.
amy: decision points for pilot: - pilot tenants (3 low-latency-critical customers) - telemetry & dashboard ready - rollback/gate: if p99 latency > +15% for >10m -> auto-disable soft mode - pricing & contract language drafted
derek: engineering asks for 3 sprint slices: infra telemetry (1), autoscale signal work (2), safe drain logic + tests (1). estimate 5 sprints total.
sofia: ops runbook draft: how to force-disable a tenant, sampling steps, and postmortem checklist. i'll start a runbook PR and the dashboard panels.
amy: next steps: @derek run resource estimate by EOW, @sofia start runbook + panel, @jason draft external language. I'll schedule a 30m decision sync next Tue. :calendar: :memo:
sofia: noted. will include a churn metric and backfill cost estimate.
jason: I'll pull customer names who matched the ask and prep outreach.
amy: thumbs: if you agree with pilot scope, reply with :thumbsup: or list blockers.
derek: :thumbsup:
sofia: :thumbsup:
jason: :thumbsup:
